stages.name: a
stages.query: SELECT __path,ast_kind AS kind,ast_name AS name,NULL AS alias,ast_module AS module,ast_value AS value,ast_value_kind AS value_kind,CAST(NULLIF(ast_preorder,'') AS INTEGER) AS id,CAST(NULLIF(NULL,'') AS INTEGER) AS bfs,CAST(NULLIF(ast_parent,'') AS INTEGER) AS parent,ast_field AS field,CAST(NULLIF(ast_index,'') AS INTEGER) AS position,CAST(NULLIF(NULL,'') AS INTEGER) AS last,CAST(NULLIF(ast_function,'') AS INTEGER) AS fn,NULL AS op,CAST(NULLIF(ast_start,'') AS INTEGER) AS __start,CAST(NULLIF(ast_stop,'') AS INTEGER) AS __end,CAST(NULLIF(ast_line,'') AS INTEGER) AS line,NULL AS context,NULL AS name_repr,NULL AS value_repr,NULL AS annotation,NULL AS annotation_repr,CAST(NULLIF(NULL,'') AS INTEGER) AS cls,CAST(NULLIF(NULL,'') AS INTEGER) AS level FROM canonical

stages.name: calls
stages.query:
SELECT c.*,f.kind AS callee_kind,f.name AS callee,f.id AS callee_id,r.id AS receiver,r.kind AS receiver_kind,r.name AS receiver_name
      FROM a c JOIN a f ON f.__path=c.__path AND f.parent=c.id AND f.field='func'
      LEFT JOIN a r ON r.__path=f.__path AND r.parent=f.id AND r.field='value'
      WHERE c.kind='Call'

stages.name: imports
stages.query: SELECT n.*,CASE WHEN n.kind='ImportFrom' THEN n.module ELSE (SELECT group_concat(name,',') FROM (SELECT name FROM a alias WHERE alias.__path=n.__path AND alias.parent=n.id AND alias.kind='alias' ORDER BY position)) END imported,(SELECT group_concat(name,' ') FROM (SELECT name FROM a alias WHERE alias.__path=n.__path AND alias.parent=n.id AND alias.kind='alias' ORDER BY position)) imported_names FROM a n WHERE n.kind IN ('Import','ImportFrom')

stages.name: hnsw_symbols
stages.query: SELECT n.*,CASE WHEN n.kind IN ('Name','Attribute') THEN n.name WHEN n.kind='Constant' AND n.value_kind='str' THEN n.value WHEN n.kind IN ('Import','ImportFrom') THEN i.imported||' '||i.imported_names ELSE '' END token FROM a n LEFT JOIN imports i ON i.__path=n.__path AND i.id=n.id
